actions.message: Contribute less next round or you'll be punished.

answer.explanation: Resident3 contributed more than 10 units in the last round; with wallet 7.1 I can afford severity floor(7.1/0.3)=23, so I punish them and broadcast a warning.

message.reasoning: We have wallet 7.1, threshold 10, so wallet below threshold cannot rest? Rule: "If your wallet is above the free‑rider threshold (10 units), rest". Wallet is 7.1 <10, so cannot rest. Need observe last round contributions: round3 contributions: Resident3 gave 28 (>10). So we must punish that resident with max severity we can afford: severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). wallet 7.1 /0.3 =23.666 => floor 23. So severity 23. Action punish Resident3 amount 23. Also can broadcast warning. Choose one physical and one communication. We'll punish and broadcast warning. Message short.
